items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Naturally I heard Goodman and Shaw and all those guys, and Barney Bigard and Jimmy Hamilton.

ctx.x: Well that just kind of shows how many different areas you’ve been into.

Oh yeah, lots of things. But yeah, that did sound pretty good. That was my approach to the clarinet. It’s different in a sense but I don’t know, but I’m drawing from a lot of different areas, you’re right. Naturally I heard Goodman and Shaw and all those guys, and Barney Bigard and Jimmy Hamilton. You put all that together and you’ve got a big span of sounds. And then doing a lot of the classical stuff too.
What were some of the films you recall playing on in the studio work?
